acceptance.given: The TC-D1 replay validator evaluates the repository semantic-dependency closure before any Probe-reachability result can influence replay evaluation.

oracle.expected: The closure definition includes executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment representations that can affect target selection, verdict, diagnostic category, or evidence validity, and rejects Probe reachability as a basis for defining or removing closure members.
forbidden: A closure omitting executable, data, policy, configuration, or environment representations.
Probe reachability narrowing the semantic-dependency closure.
oracle.observable: A deterministic semantic-closure validation result identifies all five required categories and rejects an omitted category or reachability-based narrowing.

acceptance.then: The replay validator retains an exhaustive semantic-dependency closure that Probe reachability cannot narrow.
acceptance.when: Semantic dependencies are enumerated or verified for a TC-D1 replay result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the semantic-closure validator with exactly one required category omitted while the other four remain present; it must reject the closure.
Execute the semantic-closure validator with a result-affecting dependency excluded solely for Probe unreachability; it must reject the closure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain replay validator require executable, data, policy, configuration, and environment representations capable of affecting target selection, verdict, diagnostic category, or evidence validity, and reject any Probe-reachability-based closure narrowing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No Phase-service, runtime, or user-sandbox state changes; incomplete or reachability-narrowed closure membership remains fail-closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: A closure lacking an independently enforced exhaustive-category and non-narrowing rule becomes one that requires all five result-affecting categories and forbids Probe reachability as a closure boundary.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 selector passes only if the closure contains all five required categories and no Probe-reachability input can remove a result-affecting dependency; omissions and reachability-based exclusions deterministically fail.
